cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says a government digital-skills programme for the public is in service and has trained a stated number of people. The 330 who completed the DigiTruck course were in one sub-county.
cells.note: The State Department of ICT, with Huawei, delivered DigiTruck digital-skills training in 2026, a programme under way. Its only count is 330 people in Keiyo South, one locality, which does not show a national programme counted, so not stage 3.
